description: Ministry of Ports and Shipping - The Shipping Agents (Licensing) Regulations 1991 (Amendment to the  Gaz.  Ex. Ordinary No. 684/9 of 17.10.1991.
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Ports and Shipping under the Licensing of Shipping Agents, Freight Forwarders, Non-Vessel Operating Common Carriers and Container Operators Act, No. 10 of 1972. It amends existing regulations regarding tariff charges for shipping agents, which constitutes legal/regulatory framework changes rather than government personnel or structural changes. This fits the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) as it involves statutory instruments and regulatory compliance requirements.
